bullets.text: The State Wetlands Authority told the Madras High Court that the interim zone of influence around the Pallikaranai marshland can be restricted to 36 survey numbers, giving relief to property owners, and the office should monitor this.

Shri Physio and Rehab Centre in Adyar will conduct an osteoporosis awareness and detection camp on October 20 led by Shriram Krishnamoorthy, and the constituency team should track health camp outreach.
Chennai Metro Rail's Poonamallee-Vadapalani stretch recorded over 25,000 passengers on its first day, and the district team should monitor transport updates.
Collector S. Kavitha received 501 petition applications during the grievance meeting in Thiruvallur, and the office should track grievance redressal follow-ups.
Collector Kavitha announced that the Ungalai Thedi Ungal Ooril camp will be held in R.K. Pettai taluk on October 21, and the team should watch local camp execution.
HCLTech partnered with Anthropic to expand enterprise AI deployment with a focus on safety and governance, and our portfolio team should watch enterprise AI trends.
Google defended its 15 billion dollar Vizag AI hub project by stating it will use advanced air-cooling technology, and the portfolio team should monitor infrastructure developments.
PMK leader Anbumani Ramadoss expressed anger over political actions related to Pallikaranai, and the office should monitor political reactions in the region.
DMK Parliamentary party leader Kanimozhi wrote to the Union Minister regarding the removal of criticism posts against TVK on Instagram, and the office should watch social media moderation issues.
Congress and TVK functionaries clashed in Thoothukudi over a building door, and police registered cases against both sides, which the office should monitor.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited Chennai to launch projects worth 13,000 crore rupees including the metro rail stretch, and the office should track related announcements.

stories.title: Interim zone of influence around Pallikaranai marshland can be restricted to 36 survey numbers, State Wetlands Authority tells Madras High Court
takeaways: State Wetlands Authority told High Court that Pallikaranai buffer zone can be restricted to 36 survey numbers.
This provides major relief to hundreds of property owners facing construction bans near the marsh.
